title: Provider-neutral adapter protocol and capability router

privacy.projection: identities, enums, bounded metadata and digests only

invariants: Every event repeats one exact task revision and worktree/session binding.
Secret values never cross the boundary; only secret-ref identifiers may appear.
Unsupported capability outcomes are explicit, non-executing, and non-mutating.
Close and failure fence all later events.
Capability routing is an observation, not provider support or authorization.
limitations: The checker validates supplied deterministic records only.
No provider, network, LLM, process, filesystem, credential store, or durable state is contacted or mutated.
